fields.statement: Verified commit 24ef387fc against d343922ed. Diff: only internal/api/*_test.go plus .rhiza log/rendered changed, no non-test code. testCtx(t, root) gives every Ctx IndexPath=filepath.Join(t.TempDir(),"index.db") (fresh per call, so no index shared between parallel tests); testCtxNoIndex is used only by snapshot build/copy (copy then sets its test's TempDir index), drawsOf and runRead (which sets the generated repo's index), each with a comment. Every IndexPath="" (change_indexed_test x4, write_indexed_test, inbox_fold_test, read_test) has a comment saying it exercises the fallback/fold side on purpose. No Test func deleted; go test -list '.*' ./internal/api counts 782 Test lines at both d343922ed and HEAD. Ran (all in a capped systemd scope, -p 2): go test -race -count=5 -run 'TestDaemonWebListenerFollowsPort$' exit 0; go test -count=5 -run 'TestArbiter|TestStartArbiter|TestRunCycle|TestRunLeaves' exit 0; go test -count=1 -run 'TestChangeShowIndexed|TestWritesThroughIndexMatchFold|TestInboxReadsChangeSetsOnce|TestReadOpenErrors|TestDaemonProfile' exit 0 (TestDaemonProfile tests pass without -cpuprofile); whole package once: go test -trimpath -count=1 -p 2 -shuffle=7331 ./internal/api exit 0 (227s). Profile not re-run (whole-package budget); Checks: block gives store.ReadLog cum share before 24.87% and after 23.94%, which falls. rhiza check fails only on this verifier's own unrendered actor record, as expected in a run.
